bootstrap.heading: First-time setup
bootstrap.tokenHelp: One-time token printed to the daemon log at first boot.

rules.tagline: Edit rules · define test fixtures below · Dry-run must pass before Apply.
rules.dryRunPassed_one: Dry-run passed ({{count}} fixture) — Apply is enabled.
rules.dryRunPassed_other: Dry-run passed ({{count}} fixtures) — Apply is enabled.
rules.addFixtureHint: Add at least one fixture below (domain + expected exit), then run Dry-run.
rules.runDryRunHint: Run Dry-run before Apply to guard against regressions.
rules.andMoreSeeTable: … and {{count}} more (see the results table below)
rules.noRulesYet: No rules yet. Click + Add rule above.
rules.noCustomExits: No custom exits configured yet. Add one on the <exitsLink>Exits</exitsLink> page.
rules.dryRunFixturesHelp: Each row asserts: given this domain, the ruleset must route it to the expected exit. Empty = only syntax + render check.
rules.noFixtures: No fixtures. Dry-run will still validate syntax; add fixtures if you want to assert specific routing decisions.
rules.importDescription: Fetch a Clash/mihomo-style rule list (one KIND,VALUE,POLICY line per rule) from a URL, or paste one below. All non-direct/block policies are rewritten to the action you choose so imported rules point at a real exit. Nothing is applied — the imported rules land as draft entries you can dry-run and Apply.
rules.importUrlHelp: Community-common sources (not endorsed, not preloaded): Loyalsoldier/clash-rules, ACL4SSR, MetaCubeX/meta-rules-dat. Verify the source before importing.
rules.groupDeleteAllConfirm: Delete this whole batch of {{count}} rules?
rules.sectionRulesetsHelp: Batches imported from URL or paste. Each ruleset stays as one card; expand to see individual rules or delete the whole batch.
rules.rulesetsEmpty: No rulesets registered yet. Use ⤓ Import ruleset above to add one.
rules.importAsRulesetHelp: 5GPN registers this URL as a native rule provider. The daemon re-syncs it periodically (respecting ETag) and expands its rules into the effective config at apply time.
rules.importRulesetNameHelp: Left empty = auto-generated (rs-<hex>). Use letters/digits/dot/underscore/dash, up to 64 chars.

exits.title: Exits
exits.subtitle: Add a proxy by pasting its share URI · ss / vmess / trojan / vless / hysteria2 / tuic / anytls / socks5 / http(s).

snapshots.heading: Snapshots
snapshots.subheading: Every apply writes an immutable snapshot · rollback restores the paired rule_version as active.
snapshots.emptyState: No snapshots yet — apply a ruleset from the Rules page to generate one.

backup.heading: Backup
backup.subheading: Export a plaintext archive of rules, snapshot metadata, and SQLite state. Panel import restores active rules only through the observed apply path.
backup.exportDescription: Plaintext archive containing rules/active.yaml, snapshots/manifest.json, db/5gpn.db, and a README. The database can contain secrets; store the download securely.
backup.importDescription: Panel import applies rules/active.yaml only. The bundled database and snapshot manifest are ignored and remain offline recovery artifacts.
backup.fileTooLarge: Backup must be a non-empty gzip file no larger than {{max}} MiB.
backup.confirmDialogDescription: Only rules/active.yaml will be validated and sent through the observed apply path. The database and manifest will not be restored.

logs.title: Logs
logs.subtitle: Live tail via SSE · journalctl piped from the daemon host.
logs.errorNotSignedIn: not signed in — reload the page and log back in
logs.errorConnectionClosed: connection closed (auth rejected or server dropped)

settings.subtitle: Version check, Telegram bot, iOS profile, and account password.
settings.externalUpgradeRequired: Install updates through the external installer or privileged supervisor; in-process replacement is disabled.
settings.tgbotDescription: Telegram command bot for selected diagnostics and exit operations. Saved changes take effect without restarting the daemon.
settings.botTokenHelp: Get it from BotFather. Leave empty to disable the bot.
settings.adminChatIdsHelpPrefix: Separate with spaces or commas. Send
settings.adminChatIdsHelpSuffix: to the bot to get your own chat_id.
settings.adminRequired: At least one admin chat id is required
settings.iosDescription: Unsigned encrypted-DNS profile. The local DoT preflight does not verify its public DoH endpoint or reachability from an iOS device.
settings.iosNoProfile: The backend did not return a profile link. Please enter it manually or use the system QR scanner.
settings.changePasswordDescription: After a successful change the current session will be cleared and you must sign in again.
settings.newPasswordTooShort: New password must be at least 8 characters
settings.passwordMismatch: The two new passwords do not match
settings.newPasswordSameAsCurrent: New password must be different from the current one
settings.restartDescription: Apply bind/port and TLS changes. The panel will be unreachable for a few seconds while systemd restarts the process.
settings.restartQueued: Restart queued. The panel will drop briefly and come back on the new settings.
settings.restartConfirmBody: The panel will drop for a few seconds. Any in-flight upload or dry-run will be aborted. Continue?
settings.restartUnavailable: The daemon is not managed by systemd — restart is unavailable here.
settings.iosProfileEnabledHint: Enabled — the unsigned mobileconfig link is live; local preflight is not a device-readiness check.
settings.iosProfileDisabledHint: Disabled — preflight checks only the local DoT listener before enabling the unsigned download.
settings.iosPreflightPass: Local DoT answered. The profile's public DoH endpoint and device path were not tested.
settings.iosProfileTurnedOn: Unsigned profile enabled. Public DoH and device reachability remain unverified.
settings.mtproxyDescription: Telegram's mobile app hardcodes DC IPs and bypasses DNS, so DNS spoofing can't reach it. The panel drives the externally-installed 9seconds/mtg service so clients get a fake-TLS MTProxy that fronts as a chosen HTTPS domain (e.g. www.cloudflare.com) — copy the one-shot tg://proxy link below and share it with clients.
settings.mtproxyExternalNote: This proxy uses 9seconds/mtg (external systemd service). The panel controls it via systemctl; it does not run in-process.
settings.mtproxyLoopbackFallback: Panel cannot control the mtg service (systemctl unavailable or /usr/local/bin/mtg missing). Install 9seconds/mtg first.
settings.mtproxyEnabledHint: Off = systemctl disable --now mtg (port :2443 released). On = systemctl enable --now mtg. Requires a configured secret before enable.
settings.mtproxyListenHint: Managed by the mtg systemd unit (/etc/systemd/system/mtg.service). Not panel-editable — regenerate the unit via 9seconds/mtg deploy scripts to change the port.
settings.mtproxyFrontingDomainHint: Domain the fake-TLS handshake presents as (e.g. www.cloudflare.com). Changing this regenerates the secret and rewrites the mtg unit.
settings.mtproxyRotateConfirmBody: Existing Telegram proxy links will stop working immediately. Clients must use the newly generated link.
settings.mtproxySecretRevealWarning: This is the ONLY time the full secret is displayed. Copy the tg:// link or QR now — after you leave this page it cannot be shown again, only rotated.
settings.mtproxySecretNotConfigured: Not configured yet — click Generate first.
settings.mtproxyQRHint: Scan with Telegram's built-in QR scanner, or share the tg:// URL. The link embeds the raw secret, so treat it like a password.
settings.mtproxyRestartHint: The mtg service was restarted so clients see the new secret immediately.
settings.proxyDescription: DNS spoof can direct clients to the :443 SNI/QUIC forwarders. Those forwarders currently connect directly from this host to the public destination; they do not use the selected mihomo exit.
settings.proxySpoofToggle: DNS Spoof (redirect proxy answers to this gateway)
settings.proxySpoofHint: When enabled, proxy-classified A/AAAA answers point at this gateway. Current forwarding is direct host egress, not active-exit routing. When disabled, the resolver returns real answers.
settings.proxySNIHint: Listens on TCP :443, parses the SNI from the ClientHello, and forwards to the destination. Does NOT decrypt TLS. Only useful when DNS Spoof is on.
settings.proxyQUICHint: Listens on UDP :443, parses the SNI from the QUIC Initial, and forwards to the destination. Coexists with the TCP :443 SNI forwarder.
settings.proxyScopeAll: all — spoof every proxy client (recommended for public DoH)
settings.proxyRestartHint: Restart the daemon (Settings → Restart) to apply :443 socket changes.
settings.proxyRestartRequired: Saved. Restart the daemon so port :443 changes take effect.
settings.proxySaved: Saved. Spoof policy applied live to the running resolver.
settings.internalOnlyConfirmBody: The allowlist is applied immediately. If this device is outside the configured CIDRs, this panel session will be disconnected.
settings.internalOnlyDescription: Restrict the panel and the in-process SNI/QUIC forwarders to source IPs inside the configured CIDRs. The external MTProxy service is not covered and needs its own firewall or systemd access policy.
settings.internalOnlyEnabledHint: When on, only allowlisted clients can reach the panel and in-process forwarders. Loopback is always allowed.
settings.internalOnlyCIDRHint: Comma-separated CIDR blocks. Empty falls back to private-only defaults (RFC1918 + loopback + v6 ULA).
settings.internalOnlySaved: Saved. Allowlist applied live to the panel and in-process SNI/QUIC forwarders; external MTProxy is unchanged.

wizard.heading: First-time setup
wizard.subheading: Let's get your panel configured. You can change any of this later in Settings.
wizard.serverDomainHelp: The hostname the panel serves under. Used by the TLS certificate and the iOS profile.
wizard.serverPanelBindHelp: 0.0.0.0 accepts external traffic · 127.0.0.1 restricts to SSH tunnel
wizard.serverPanelPortHelp: 443 = default HTTPS. 8443 = current default if you cannot free port 443.
wizard.tlsEnableLabel: Enable automatic TLS via Let's Encrypt
wizard.tlsEnableHelp: Requires port 80 free on this host. The daemon requests + auto-renews the certificate.
wizard.tlsEmailHelp: Sent to the CA as your ACME account owner — used for expiry reminders.
wizard.tlsPortRequiresAcme: Port {{port}} is reserved for TLS. Turn on Auto-SSL, or move the panel to another port.
wizard.tgbotIntro: Optional — set up a Telegram command bot for /status, /exits, and selected diagnostics without opening the panel.
wizard.tgbotTokenHelp: From @BotFather. Leave empty to disable the bot for now.
wizard.tgbotAdminIdsHelp: Comma or space separated numeric IDs. Send /id to the bot to get yours.
wizard.tgbotRequireIds: Provide at least one admin chat ID when a token is set.
wizard.reviewIntro: Review your choices. Nothing is written until you click Finish.
wizard.reviewTlsOff: disabled — using existing config.yaml TLS if set, plain HTTP otherwise
wizard.restartHint: Bind / port changes require a daemon restart to take effect. Use Settings → Restart daemon after finishing.
wizard.tgbotWarningTitle: TG bot rejected by Telegram — other settings were saved
wizard.tgbotWarningBody: Telegram returned: {{detail}}. Your domain, panel port, and TLS settings are already saved. Retype or clear the token to enable the bot, or continue to the dashboard and fix it later in Settings.
